searxng.description: Web search via SearXNG (meta search - Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, etc.)
searxng._note: Disabled: replaced by PAAW's native in-process search tools (searxng__searxng_web_search / searxng__web_url_read) which call the SearXNG service over HTTP directly - no per-tool container. Set SEARXNG_URL on the paaw service to override.

mcp-discord.description: Send and fetch messages from Discord channels

whatsapp.description: Send WhatsApp messages via the PAAW WhatsApp bot (Baileys). Talks to the bot's HTTP bridge - it does NOT open its own WhatsApp session.
whatsapp._note: Disabled: replaced by PAAW's native in-process WhatsApp tools (whatsapp__send_whatsapp_to_me, etc.) which call the bot bridge (WHATSAPP_BRIDGE_URL, default http://whatsapp:3000) directly - no per-tool container. The 'whatsapp' service (bridge on :3000) must still be running.

_comment: Set 'enabled: true' to activate an MCP server. PAAW will start it automatically. Use ${VAR} for environment variables.
